## Per-Subject Overview

```{r}
#| label: subject-overview
#| results: asis
cat(as_raw_html(apa_gt(
  subj %>% select(dataset, group, n_channels, n_trials, n_discarded, n_kept,
                  pct_rejected, n_truncated, pct_flagged, pct_interpolated,
                  pct_outlier, median_baseline_sd, median_sme),
  "Data Quality by Subject (worst rejection rate first)")))
```

```{r}
#| label: subject-overview-plot
#| fig-height: 5
# Ordered by rejection rate rather than alphabetically: the reason to look at
# this plot at all is to find the tail, and an alphabetical axis hides it.
sp <- subj %>%
  mutate(dataset = fct_reorder(dataset, pct_rejected)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pct_rejected, y = dataset)) +
  geom_col(fill = alz_blue, width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(subj$pct_rejected, na.rm = TRUE),
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  labs(x = "Trials rejected (%)", y = NULL,
       subtitle = "Dashed line: median across subjects") +
  alz_theme()
print(sp)
```
